description: Use when an agent needs recent public contract award notices with the winning companies: per award title, buyer, winner names, country, value, date and notice link. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /tenders/awards, $0.01 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

country.description: Buyer country, ISO alpha-2: EU/EEA member states and CH (TED), GB (Contracts Finder), US (USAspending). Omit with q to search all three.

q.description: Keywords (1-6 words, every word has to match), e.g. cloud hosting. Needed unless country is given.

name: tenders_awards
title: Tenders awards
